58360 A widow is not entitled to WMA or WP for any period after she remarries or forms a civil partnership

58361  	A widow who has remarried or formed a civil partnership may seek reinstatement of her WMA or WP if her remarriage or civil partnership has been declared void or voidable. It is possible to reinstate WMA or WP following a void marriage or civil partnership. Such action is not possible, except in Scotland, in the case of a voidable marriage or civil partnership. Guidance on void and voidable marriages and civil partnerships is in DMG Chapter 10.
